newsitem.title: USA: 1st United Bancorp to acquire Fla bank.
newsitem.headline: 1st United Bancorp to acquire Fla bank.

text.p: 1st United Bancorp said on Friday it has acquire Park Bankshares Inc.
1st United said it issued 818,000 shares of common stock to acquire Park Bankshares. The deal also includes Park's wholly owned subsidiary, First National Bank of Lake Park.
The acquisition is expected to be accounted for as a pooling of interest, 1st United said in a prepared statement.
1st United operates 31 bank branches in Palm Beach, southern Martin, northern Broward and throughout Brevard counties.
1st United did not disclose a dollar value for the deal.
